rules.description: List of access control rules. Rules are processed in order; first match takes effect. Each rule specifies permission, users, and origins.

comment.description: Optional one-line comment explaining the rule's purpose (shown before the rule in config).

allow.description: Whether to allow (true) or deny (false) access for this rule.

users.description: List of users or groups affected by this rule. Group names must be prefixed with '@'. Use 'ALL' to match any user.

origins.description: List of hosts or networks from which access is allowed/denied. Accepts hostnames, IP addresses, CIDR notation, and special values like 'ALL', 'LOCAL', 'REMOTE'.
